rules.text:
The twelve directions, docs/dzql/rendering/bento/README.md

The box
1 A page is a box of compartments, or one on its own.
2 It lays itself out from what it holds.
3 A compartment grows into the window.

Where am I
4 The name, and the trail back up.
5 The same place read another way.

Cards and pins
6 A pin opens a popover; it grows into the full calendar or map.

What can I do
7 A tap does what it names.
8 Make or remove in a modal; change in a drawer.
9 One overlay at a time, each a step.
10 Offer only what this person may do.

What happened
11 Every change says what it did.
12 A thing once on a page, in plain words.
